name: room everywhere: green
a NoSchedule taint keeps out a pod that doesn't tolerate it; one that does moves there
a PreferNoSchedule taint doesn't keep anything out
the small taint keeps out core pods; a pod tolerating it moves there
required affinity: a pod pinned to main can't move to edge, an unpinned one can
cpu requests count too
hostname anti-affinity: a vault member with no free node runs degraded (yellow, P7)
hostname anti-affinity with a fourth node: the member moves (green)
DoNotSchedule spread: the member moves to the emptiest node
the reference layout (two non-small main nodes and a small tie-breaker): degraded sets, yellow (P7)
a set that can't keep its minimum is red (min = members)
a node already NotReady: its members don't count, losing another node breaks the quorum (red)
a high pod that fits only by evicting a normal pod: yellow
a high pod that evicts only a low pod: green
a critical pod evicts a normal pod: green
never an eviction of a pod at or above the pod's own priority, nor of a critical or high pod: red
preemptionPolicy Never: a low pod never evicts, a normal one evicts low pods
DaemonSet pods are never placed (but count where they run)
DaemonSet pods count where they run: no room left
a cordoned node takes nothing
